name: Teen Art Project (TAP)
what_you_do: Work with visiting artists to make art. In the Fall 2026 project, teens help make a large textile artwork with artist Amanda Browder for four weeks. Then they work with a new artist and art style each week for four more weeks.
who_can_apply: Enrolled high school students (per the summer program page). The Fall 2026 event page does not list ages.
pay_detail: Cost and stipend are not stated on the program pages.
duration: Summer program. Fall 2026 project: 8 weeks, Thursdays 2:30 to 5 PM, Oct 1 to Nov 19, 2026
deadline_text: The page says applications for Summer TAP 2027 will open in spring 2027. No deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Subscribe to the museum newsletter to hear when enrollment opens. For the Fall 2026 project use the Register button on its event page. Museum phone: 406-728-0447.
notes: It is not clear if the Fall 2026 project is part of the same program as Summer TAP. Ask the museum.
